tim-eddy.t: Appointed Director 9 December 2019 and Chair 21 June 2024

Mr Eddy had a successful 40-year career at Ernst & Young including the positions of Managing Partner Operations – Oceania, Global Vice Chair – EY Global Services and National Managing Partner – EY Transaction Advisory Services. He currently serves as a Director of Western Sydney Airport, Chair of The Red Fox Group, Rennie Advisory and BIO101 Financial Advisory.

Mr Eddy is a member of the Racing Victoria Audit, Risk & Welfare Sub Committee and the Racing Sub Committee. Mr Eddy is Chair of the Racing Victoria & Country Racing Victoria Steering Committee and the Racing Victoria Members Consultative Committee. Mr Eddy is a Director of Racing Australia and is also Chair of Equine Welfare Advisory Council.

sharon-mccrohan.t: Appointed Director 9 October 2017 and Deputy Chair 21 June 2024

Ms McCrohan has a career spanning almost 30 years as a journalist and adviser to Federal and Victorian Government leaders and cabinets, private sector boards, sporting bodies, charities and Government agencies. She is a Director of the Transport Accident Commission and also serves on
the board of the Ovarian Cancer Research Foundation.
Ms McCrohan is a member of the Racing Sub Committee, the Racing Integrity & Equine Welfare
Sub Committee and the Racing Victoria Members Consultative Committee.

aaron-morrison.t: Prior to his appointment as CEO, Mr Morrison was the Chief Financial Officer / Chief Operating Officer of Racing Victoria since 2017. Mr Morrison has had an extensive and successful career across the entertainment, hospitality and gaming sectors. Before joining Racing Victoria, Mr Morrison was Chief Executive Officer of the Sand Hill Road Group and held senior executive and advisory positions with Crown Resorts Ltd and SkyCity Entertainment Group.

Mr Morrison is a Director of Racing Victoria subsidiaries; Racing.com Media Pty Ltd, Director, Racing.com Pty Ltd, Director, RVL Media Pty Ltd, Director, Thoroughbred Racing Productions (Victoria) Pty Ltd, Director, VTRI Property Pty Ltd, Director VicRacing Audio Services Pty Ltd (formerly 3UZ Pty Ltd), Director, VicRacing Pty Ltd, Director, Sports Wagering Integrity Monitoring Ltd (SWIM).

kate-joel.t: Ms Joel has been a business consultant for over 30 years and currently serves on the Board of the Florey Institute of Neuroscience & Mental Health, having served on the Florey Foundation since 2017. Previously, Ms Joel was CEO of Leonard Joel Auction House and was a member of the Melbourne and Olympic Parks Trust and the Board of Harness Racing Victoria. Prior to joining the Board, Ms Joel served on the RV Integrity Council from 2014-2017. Ms Joel grew up riding trackwork and her involvement in the racing industry spans over 55 years.
Ms Joel is Chair of the Racing Integrity & Equine Welfare Sub Committee and a member of the Racing Victoria Audit, Risk & Welfare Sub Committee.

ross-lanyon.t: Mr Lanyon is the Managing Director of ENG Media which operates in Regional Victoria. He has received

an OAM for his services to thoroughbred racing and the Community of Mildura and was the Chair of Country Racing Victoria from 2011 to 2014. Mr Lanyon is also Chair of the Mallee Health Foundation and he is a Director of Mildura District Hospital Fund Ltd and Clay Hero Pty Ltd.

Mr Lanyon is a Director of Racing.com Media Pty Ltd and its subsidiaries. Mr Lanyon is also a member of the Racing Victoria & Country Racing Victoria Steering Committee and the Racing Integrity & Equine Welfare Sub Committee.

paul-guerra.t: Mr Guerra has extensive business experience across a breadth of industries and is currently the
CEO of the Melbourne Football Club. Prior to this he was the CEO of Victorian Chamber of Commerce and Industry, the CEO of the Royal Agricultural Society of Victoria, as well as senior Executive and
CEO roles across Asia Pacific with UnitedHealth Group, Vodafone and Motorola. Mr Guerra has significant Board experience, including previous Chairman roles with Queen Victoria Market and
Myagi Ltd amongst others and is currently a Director of Victoria Police Blue Ribbon Foundation.
Mr Guerra is a Director of Racing.com Media Pty Ltd and its subsidiaries.

mark-player.t: Mr Player has been a highly respected member of the international thoroughbred racing and
breeding industry for more than 25 years, working in senior positions at the Hong Kong Jockey
Club and New Zealand Thoroughbred Marketing.
Mr Player founded International Thoroughbred Solutions in 2011, an independent thoroughbred consultancy business and is the Executive Chairman of Macedon Lodge.
Mr Player is Chair of the Racing Sub Committee. Mr Player is also a member of the Racing Victoria

tim-rourke.t: Mr Rourke has extensive business experience and is the current Chief Executive Officer and director of CitiPower, Powercor, United Energy and related companies. Mr Rourke also currently serves as a director of Energy Networks Australia.
Prior to his current appointments, Mr Rourke has held various senior positions across the energy
sector since 1995 and is also an active thoroughbred owner and breeder.
Mr Rourke is Chair of the Racing Victoria Audit, Risk & Welfare Sub Committee. Mr Rourke is also
a member of the Racing Sub Committee.
